lines.text: Many learners say: She gave me many advices.
Better: She gave me a lot of advice.
Advice! He gave me some advice.

data.right: She gave me a lot of advice.

native.tip: En français, « des conseils » prend un s. En anglais, “advice” n’en prend jamais.
native.caption: Vous dites “She gave me many advices.” ? Ce mot n’a pas de pluriel ! Dites plutôt “She gave me a lot of advice.” — écoutez Ama et répétez avec elle ! Plus d’exercices dans l’appli Lexkite.

en.tip: Many learners add an s, but “advice” never takes an s.
en.caption: Do you say this? “She gave me many advices.” This word has no plural! Say “She gave me a lot of advice.” Listen to Ama and repeat with her! More exercises in the Lexkite app.
